questions_and_answers.question_text: हम लोगों को अपने शहर में सब सामान मिलता था ।

answers.answer_text: We used to get all the goods in our own city.

questions_and_answers.question_text: उन लोगों को अपने देश की सब चीजें यहाँ नहीं मिलती थीं ।

answers.answer_text: Those people could not get all the things from their own country here.

questions_and_answers.question_text: इस जहाज पर सब किस्म का खाना नहीं मिलता था ।

answers.answer_text: On this ship, food of every kind was not available.

questions_and_answers.question_text: क्या आपको मालूम है कि अच्छी मिठाइयां पहले कहाँ मिलती थीं ?

answers.answer_text: Do you know where good sweets used to be available before?

questions_and_answers.question_text: क्या पहले कभी वाशिंगटन में हिन्दुस्तानी चीजें मिलती थीं ?

answers.answer_text: Were Indian things available in Washington before?

questions_and_answers.question_text: क्या उन्हें पिछले साल श्रम करने का समय मिलता था ?

answers.answer_text: Did they have time to work last year?

questions_and_answers.question_text: दो साल पहले आपके माली को कितना वेतन मिलता था ?

answers.answer_text: How much salary did your gardener receive two years ago?
